scope: Catalytic identity only; separate from subgroup, complete complex and molecular function. Public profile matches and ligands cannot individually prove H2 catalysis. No folding, metal occupancy or activity claim.
training_selection: Core-audited development and original references, with exact hash-pinned primary Hmd identity adjudications; immutable historical labels remain separately preserved. No calibration/final prototypes.

calibration_selection.ranking: Highest true-positive count, then larger competitor margin, domain coverage and core similarity. Evaluate each family separately; no qualifying rule means no high-confidence rule for that family. Confidence intervals and component-representative counts must be reported.
calibration_selection.interpretation: Point estimates select an engineering rule; small/correlated calibration samples do not establish a population precision guarantee. Final source-separated testing remains required.

rules: Required single-polypeptide reviewed ligand set, local contexts and whole-template span must be supported. Split/fused-template and exact noncanonical exceptions remain outside new high-confidence calibration.
Partial CDS, unknown family, absent core, or ambiguous active-site map cannot enter high-confidence output.
Core similarity is matching residues divided by reviewed query-core positions within one significant local alignment, not full-protein bitscore or a combined P value.
A positive family prototype must exceed every comparable negative, indeterminate and other-family prototype by the selected margin. Exact ties never pass.
Development diagnostics exclude same homolog component or genus prototypes; original references remain exposure controls, not independent positives.

Train, calibration and final source hashes and own-library homology/taxonomy separation must be rechecked before final confirmation prediction. Candidate-discovery final results do not validate this new stage.
No gene names, organism physiology, KO or HydDB subgroup names become query mechanism evidence.

Original unresolved functional kind is unchanged. Only an exact sequence in a frozen reference_overlap positive identity unit can supply positive catalytic identity, under a separate accession/hash review; otherwise retain indeterminate identity. No functional reference is enabled.
